## Question 4 - Knn Model 
```{r KNN}
library(class)
library(ggplot2)

pca_data<-as.data.frame(cancer_PC$x[, 1:7]) #the data frame of the PCA from 1 to 7 (which is the 90% variablity)
classes<-BCWData_balanced$Class #The 2 classes, benign or malignant
pca_com<-as.data.frame(cancer_PC$x[, 1:7])
pca_com$label<-classes

set.seed(1234) #to ensure consistency
size<-floor(0.8*nrow(pca_data)) #382 observations in the training sample while 96 in the testing sample

#splitting the data into a testing and training sample
train_sample<-sample(seq_len(nrow(pca_data)),size=size)
#training data
cancer_train<-pca_data[train_sample,]
train_class<-classes[train_sample]
#testing data
cancer_test<-pca_data[-train_sample,]
test_class<-classes[-train_sample]

#K-NN with the training sample as train, testing sample as test, the classes as cl, and k=19 (high enough compared to the training sample)
cancer_knn <- knn(train = cancer_train, test = cancer_test, cl=train_class, k = 19, prob = TRUE)
#This will show how much K-NN predicted in benign (2) or malignant (4)
summary(cancer_knn)


x_seq <- seq(min(pca_data$PC1) - 1, max(pca_data$PC1) + 1, length.out = 200)
y_seq <- seq(min(pca_data$PC2) - 1, max(pca_data$PC2) + 1, length.out = 200)
grid_points <- expand.grid(PC1 = x_seq, PC2 = y_seq)

# Predict K-NN labels on the grid for decision boundaries
grid_knn <- knn(train = cancer_train[, c("PC1", "PC2")], 
                test = grid_points, cl = train_class, k = 19)
grid_points$label <- as.factor(grid_knn)  # Convert to factor for discrete coloring


#This is to help visualize the predicted K-NN with respect to the PCs
knn_complete<-data.frame(PC1=cancer_test$PC1,
                            PC2=cancer_test$PC2,
                            PC3=cancer_test$PC3,
                            PC4=cancer_test$PC4,
                            PC5=cancer_test$PC5,
                            PC6=cancer_test$PC6,
                            PC7=cancer_test$PC7,
                            knn=cancer_knn)

#As examples to visualize the K-NN predication
ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = grid_points, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = label), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_contour(data = grid_points, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, z = as.numeric(label)), color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data=knn_complete, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = knn),size = 3) +
  labs(title = "K-NN Classification with PCA (PC1 vs PC2)",
       x = "Principal Component 1", y = "Principal Component 2",
       fill = "K-NN Prediction (Boundary)",
       color = "K-NN Prediction (Points)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightblue", "pink")) +  # Decision boundary colors
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "red")) +  
  theme_minimal()+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-3, 6), ylim = c(-3,3))

```

## Question 5 - Confusion Matrix 
```{r Confusion Matrix}
library(caret)

confusion_matrix <- table(Predicted = cancer_knn, Actual = test_class)
print(confusion_matrix)
```

## Question 6 - Classification Quality

Extract value from the confusion matrix
```{r Extract value, echo=FALSE}
TP <- confusion_matrix[2, 2]
TN <- confusion_matrix[1, 1]
FP <- confusion_matrix[2, 1]
FN <- confusion_matrix[1, 2]

cat("True positive :", TP, "\n")
cat("True negative :", TN, "\n")
cat("False positive :", FP, "\n")
cat("False negative :", FN, "\n")
```

Calculate the performances
```{r Performance Calculation, echo=FALSE}
accuracy <- (TP + TN) / (TP + FP + FN + TN)
recall <- TP / (TP + FN)
specificity <- TN / (FP + TN)
precision <- TP / (TP + FP)
f1_score <- (2 * TP) / (2 * TP + FP + FN)
```

Calculate the AUC
Reference: https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/plotting-roc-curve-in-r-programming/ 
```{r AUC Calculation, echo=FALSE}
library(pROC)

# Only probability can calculate AUC
knn_probs <- attr(cancer_knn, "prob")
knn_probs <- ifelse(cancer_knn == "Malignant", knn_probs, 1 - knn_probs)

roc_curve <- roc(test_class, knn_probs)
plot(roc_curve, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curve", print.auc = TRUE)
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "red")

auc <- as.numeric(roc_curve$auc)
```

Display Performance Result
```{r Performance Output}
cat("Knn Model Performance Metrics\n")
cat("---------------------------\n")
cat("Accuracy:", round(accuracy, 4), "\n")
cat("Recall:", round(recall, 4), "\n")
cat("Specificity:", round(specificity, 4), "\n")
cat("Precision:", round(precision, 4), "\n")
cat("F1 Score:", round(f1_score, 4), "\n")
cat("AUC:", round(auc, 4), "\n")
```
